_comment: Copy to forward_levels.json and fill in. That filename is gitignored,
so licensed forward assessments stay out of this public repository.
Use the BASELOAD forward for the forecast window, not peak: the model
applies an intraday shape from ENTSO-E on top of this level, so a peak
assessment would count the daily shape twice.
currency: EUR or GBP. EUR is converted at the ECB daily reference rate.
Omit a link, or set it to null, to use the trailing ENTSO-E mean instead.
The values below are placeholders, not assessments.
